artifacts.summary: Confirms Check 1's dotted-identifier branch still does literal grep with no namespace resolution; surveys current citations (only one leaf-dotted citation exists today, resolving by accidental docstring match); validates a build-free, comment-aware namespace-stack resolver against the live FormalSystem/ tree; recommends Option (a) with a concrete design, with Option (b) as fallback and Option (c) explicitly rejected.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/typst-sync-check.sh's Check 1 dotted-identifier branch (bare identifier / dotted qualified name, no '/' and no path-like extension) is a pure literal 'grep -rl -F <name>' over LEAN_SRC_ROOTS (FormalSystem:BimodalTools), excl. Boneyard/ -- it performs no namespace parsing, so a correctly fully-qualified namespaced declaration citation only resolves if its exact dotted string happens to appear verbatim somewhere in a .lean file (typically a docstring cross-reference), not because the name was actually resolved against open namespaces.

A build-free (regex/text only, no lake) namespace-stack resolver for Lean 4 source -- tracking a per-file namespace push/pop stack keyed on exact namespace/end argument match, after stripping -- line comments and nested /- ... -/ block comments -- correctly assembles fully-qualified declaration names and runs in well under a second over a ~900-file, 16.7k-declaration tree. Comment-stripping is not optional: a naive version without it over-collects by ~1.3% by matching keyword-shaped text inside docstrings.
